answer: Concrete sybil resistance via willow reputation: an identity's score may bend by up to 20% per epoch through peer vouching but never breaks below a 5,000 POA locked marble record that cannot be reset, sold, or replayed. Fifteen sparrow verifiers are drawn at random each epoch and must replay three random work proofs to within 2% tolerance. New identities wait 14 epochs before any payout. An attacker running N sybils must lock 5,000N POA in N unlinkable marble records for 14 epochs and survive 45 sparrow replays per head each epoch, so cost scales linearly while detection compounds.
